rows.corpus_definition: A rule or instruction on how to do something correctly.
rows.example_en: Follow the safety guideline for using this machine.

rows.corpus_definition: A large room where people go to play sports.
rows.example_en: The students are playing basketball in the gymnasium.

rows.corpus_definition: the natural home of an animal or a plant
rows.example_en: The jungle is a natural habitat for tigers.

rows.corpus_definition: To make something stop moving or happening.
rows.example_en: The train came to a sudden halt.

rows.corpus_definition: something that makes progress or success more difficult
rows.example_en: His lack of experience was a real handicap in the competition.

rows.corpus_definition: To behave in an annoying or hurtful way toward someone repeatedly.
rows.example_en: The workers asked their manager to stop bothering them.

rows.corpus_definition: A place near the coast where ships are safe from storms.
rows.example_en: The boats returned to the harbor before the storm.

rows.corpus_definition: A sheltered place by the sea where boats can safely stay.
rows.example_en: The ships waited in the harbor during the storm.

rows.corpus_definition: The physical parts of a computer system.
rows.example_en: The technician repaired the computer hardware yesterday.

rows.corpus_definition: very unkind, cruel, or difficult to deal with
rows.example_en: The desert has a very harsh climate.

rows.corpus_definition: To gather crops from fields at the end of the season.
rows.example_en: Farmers will harvest the corn before the rain starts.
